alerts.chooseProject: Choose a project to announce a crisis alert on it.
alerts.heading: Crisis alerts
alerts.issued: {waiting, plural, =0 {{count, plural, =0 {Alert recorded, but XOS could not reach anyone on this project. Tell people by radio or in person now.} one {Alert going to # person, {onSite} of them clocked in on this project. Inbox has it now; push and text reach phones within minutes, and email can take longer for a large alert.} other {Alert going to # people, {onSite} of them clocked in on this project. Inbox has it now; push and text reach phones within minutes, and email can take longer for a large alert.}}} one {Alert recorded and going to {count} so far, with # more person still being told. Use radio or tell people in person too.} other {Alert recorded and going to {count} so far, with # more people still being told. Use radio or tell people in person too.}} XOS does not contact emergency services.
alerts.messageHelp: What people must do now, in one or two sentences.
alerts.none: No crisis alert is active. Announce one under an emergency code when an emergency starts.
alerts.reach: {count, plural, =0 {XOS could not reach anyone. Tell people by radio or in person.} one {Sent to # person, {onSite} of them clocked in.} other {Sent to # people, {onSite} of them clocked in.}}
alerts.reachNotSent: {count, plural, one {XOS could not send it to # person. Tell them by radio or in person.} other {XOS could not send it to # people. Tell them by radio or in person.}}
alerts.reachSoFar: Sent to {count} so far, {onSite} of them clocked in.
alerts.reachWaiting: {count, plural, one {# more person still being told.} other {# more people still being told.}}
alerts.reachHelp: XOS tells the people clocked in on or assigned to this project and its dispatchers, through their Inbox, push, email and, for those who turned it on, text. The Inbox has it at once; push and text reach phones within minutes, and email can take longer for a large alert. It does not contact emergency services: in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

closeHelp: Closing records you as the person signing off. The reporter of a critical incident cannot sign off its closure.

codes.canonWord: The code word {code} and its color stay as the Standard Library has them, so crisis alerts and protocols still find it.
codes.explain: Your organization's emergency codes, in the order your people learn them. Each is your copy of a Standard Library code, so you can relabel, redescribe or reorder it. Open a code to read its protocol for each operational domain; agencies come from the project's jurisdiction.
codes.genericAgencies: Choose a project to name the responding agencies of its jurisdiction; without one, each step names the generic service.
codes.noProtocols: This code has no protocol in the Standard Library yet.
codes.notAdopted: These are the Standard Library's codes. Adopt the Standard Library in Settings, Canon Extensions to get your own copy you can edit.

dispatchEmpty: No open incidents. New reports appear here within seconds.
empty: No incidents reported. Report one as soon as something happens on site.
emptyFiltered: No incidents match these filters. Clear a filter to see every incident.
liveNotice: This board updates live as incidents are reported and dispatched.
mediaUriHelp: The path of a photo or video already uploaded from Compass, such as org/incidents/gate.jpg.
medicalNotice: Medical notes are restricted: they show only to people with the medical records permission and never leave Atlas in exports or AI features.
nearMiss: A near miss could have hurt someone or caused damage but did not. Report it here as an incident: choose Level 5 - Advisory and start What happened with the words Near miss. To find near misses later, filter Incidents by Level 5 - Advisory and look for those words.
partyDescriptionHelp: For example witness, or a description of someone unknown.
patientHelp: Who was treated, without medical detail, such as adult guest.

radio.empty: No radio plan yet. Add channels or start from the Standard Library plan.
radio.imported: {count, plural, =0 {Every library channel is already in the plan.} one {# channel added from the library.} other {# channels added from the library.}}
radio.libraryHelp: Channels the project already uses are skipped.
radio.name: Name
radio.chooseProject: Choose the project whose radio channels you want to set up.

responderCount: {count, plural, =0 {no responders} one {# responder} other {# responders}}
timeZoneHelp: Times are in {zone}, the project's time zone.
title: What happened
treatmentNotesHelp: Restricted. Encrypted at rest and shown only to people with the medical records permission.
chooseProject: Choose the project where the incident happened, then report it.
noProjects: There are no projects you can open yet. Create a project, then come back to report incidents.
